annotation.title_clean: France 2030 : 3 nouveaux dispositifs lancés pour faire de la France la pionnière de l’IA et de la robotique
annotation.title_en: France 2030: 3 new schemes launched to make France the pioneer in AI and robotics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique
annotation.venue: Salle de presse, Ministère de l'Économie
annotation.summary_en: French government press release (13 June 2025) announcing three France 2030 schemes on AI-robotics convergence: a €30M CNRS-led robotics research acceleration programme, a call for expressions of interest on robotics and intelligent machines, and a future 'AI Pioneer' fund. Also mentions the military Pendragon project and funded projects. Industrial-policy focus, no regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Launch of a €30M robotics research acceleration programme piloted by CNRS
Call for expressions of interest 'Robotique et machine intelligente' to identify needs and plan dedicated calls for projects
Future 'Pionnier de l'IA' scheme to finance disruptive AI innovation including robotics
Programme agencies tasked with robotics foresight, public-private partnerships and international collaboration
Defence ministry's Pendragon project for collective intelligence among robotic platforms
